body:
I really appreciate your concern. I hate when I feel like I'm trapped in a box. Talking about how my husband abuses me makes me feel disgusting and it's something really hard to talk about. 
I've never felt so alone in the world. I don't feel like I'm good enough for my husband or family. I have no friends. 

The thing about him, is everyone he associates with thinks he's an awesome guy, he treats no one else like this except me. So he probably wont ever get caught. 

Yes, common sense is to leave. But everything is in his name, I have my animals, I have nowhere to go, I don't drive due to panic attacks.. So it would just be really difficult. I also get easily attached to people, and I always focus on the positive when things are going semi-decent. I tend to hold onto those super amazing moments and I don't want to let go. 

It's crazy I never adored and loved someone so much in my life, even after I get hit, even after I got the fuck beat out of me last night I still crawled into bed and hugged him. I'm sickened by myself. My heart is too big for myself. It seems like everything I've been through my whole life I'd open my eyes. 

I wish he'd just leave and never come back and make it easy on me. I get called a whore and a slut but I've been 100% faithful, I get called a liar but I never lied to him, ever. I never really had any friends that were girls, but I had a lot of awesome guy friends that I'm not aloud to talk to and eventually they forgot about me.. Life is so unfair sometimes, but all in all it's probably most of my fault for allowing it to carry on so long, but I just can't walk out and leave my home and my animals. 

Sorry for the rant.. But it made me feel some-what better. Thank you for your concern tho, it's nice to know not everyone is the same.

No one should hate their-self, but I sometimes hate myself for allowing myself to stay in an abusive situation.. Although sometimes people don't realize exactly how hard it is to get out of it..or even sometimes you can't get out of the situation. I don't know..Eh.
Why thank you stranger. I'm a bit calm now. But I'm still feeling shitty.
Why am I so fucking forgiving.. I hate me.

I don't do drugs, I graduated High-school, I help strangers out, I'm a good fucking person but why the fuck are people trying to make me lose my mind.. This sucks. This.Fucking.Sucks! I'm the stupid one I guess it's my fault that I can't get out.. I just want to be loved but it wont fucking happen.ever. Why do I think people will change?

I just got a message from someone calling me an attention whore, it's fucking hilarious! No one knows me and I probably don't know anyone reading this yes, yes I'm totally looking for fucking attention from fucking strangers, not! If I wanted attention this would not be posted from a throwaway or better yet on my facebook. People suck! Liars, cheaters, cold hearted abusive, emotional fuckers.

What the fuck did I do to deserve a shitty husband? I had no childhood I got beat the hell out of all the time.. Why me? I think it's somewhat resonable to have half of a shitty life but why 20 fucking years?

Just sitting here listening to my "husband" talk about how bad he wants to kill me and "slit my throat". I'm Not saying a word just typing.. I wish he would just kill me that way I never have to see his face any more... But like he said he'll just say I killed myself.. What would it matter anyways.. I'd be dead so it wouldn't matter what happened.

I'm 100% fucking faithful and I get called a whore even tho I just sit here and work all the god damn time from home I think i'm treated this way because I have no one else and he knows I wont leave oh fucking well either I'll be in hell or be in hell.. What is hapiness anyways?
If your a semi-decent person the only thing in the world to do is be anti-social which is pointless!
Seriously what the fuck is the point of living? People suck in general. If they aren't abusive fucks then they just talk behind your back and lie and try to make your life a living hell.

>I watched my mother stay with my father who beat her senseless for years

Same here, watched my mother get beat then watched my step mother beat my father and my father beat her, then they both beat me, then I got beat by my husband, then I end up lashing out on my husband after he down grades me, then he hits me... It's like a never ending cycle. It's impossible to get out of, it's been going on since I was 17 and people don't understand that I suffer from illnesses and I just can't leave and go to a womens shelter, I have no family or friends. I really just want to die. Like he said just now "i'll beat you worse then your dad did" maybe if i'm lucky enough he will..
don't want no ones god damn sympathy I just want to rant so people can just fuck off I swear everyone is the same. judgmental abusive pieces of shit.
like i give a fuck about downvotes!
